  PROBLEM: The rewritten parenthetical says waivers match "only when every category, severity and exploit scenario the waiver recorded also matches", dropping the legacy-no-scenario caveat. The runtime code in both scripts/security_audit.sh (matching_waiver) and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (security_pass_apply_waivers_to_findings) still skips the exploit_scenario equality check when the waiver has no recorded scenario (`if waived_scenario and waived_scenario != finding_scenario: continue`), so a legacy waiver row without an exploit_scenario still suppresses by exact finding_id + matching category + matching severity. The README "Security backstop" sentence still preserves this caveat correctly.
  WHY: This is a documentation drift, not a runtime bug — the code path is correct and only agents.md misdescribes the legacy case. A future agent reasoning about waiver eligibility from agents.md will incorrectly conclude that waivers without an exploit_scenario cannot match at all, and may either fail to suppress a legitimate legacy re-report or propose to remove a working fallback.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- agents.md: ~1927-1928
  Issue: The new text says waivers match "only when every category, severity and exploit scenario the waiver recorded also matches", but the runtime code bypasses each check when the recorded value is empty (`if waived_category and ...`, `if waived_severity and ...`, `if waived_scenario and ...`). A waiver row with no `exploit_scenario` still suppresses by exact id plus matching category and severity. The README "Security backstop" sentence at line ~2641 preserves the legacy caveat ("Legacy rows without an exploit scenario still match by exact ID, provided any recorded category and severity match") but agents.md drops it.
  Suggested fix: Append the legacy caveat, e.g. "A waiver row whose recorded category, severity or exploit scenario is empty skips that check; a legacy row with no scenario still matches by exact id plus matching category and severity."
  Estimated lines changed: 2
  Verification: The poller code at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6558-6566` shows `if waived_category and ...`, `if waived_severity and ...`, `if waived_scenario and ...` — each check is skipped when the recorded value is empty. The engine code at `scripts/security_audit.sh:1789-1797` shows the same pattern. The test `test_security_audit_waived_findings_are_listed_as_accepted_and_suppressed` includes `waived-id-only` (a waiver with only a finding_id, no other fields) which IS suppressed, proving the empty-field bypass works. The agents.md text as written could mislead an AI agent into thinking a waiver without an exploit_scenario cannot suppress anything.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus
